name: race_time_penalty_per_life
description: Race time (design 1.3): the tick a team clears wave 12 plus 600 ticks (10 s) for every life it lost (SimMatch.race_time, -1 until it has cleared; race_penalty_t is the rival line's '+30 s'). Team A clears at tick 0 with 3 lives lost: race time 1800. The race is decided as soon as the outcome is certain: team B could still beat or equal 1800 until tick 1800, so the match runs on to then and team A wins by time (EV_RACE cleared, then decided). A rival that clears 600 ticks later having lost nothing wins on time instead; one that clears exactly 1200 ticks after a team that lost 2 lives draws (its window held open with a countdown write, so it clears only when it calls the wave).

steps.assert: m.race_time(0) == -1 and m.race_time(1) == -1 and m.decided_by() == '' and m.outcomes() == [] and m.life_t == 600
steps.msg: no race time before a clear, nothing decided
three lives lost: 30 s on team A's time
team A cleared at tick 0: race time 0 + 3 x 600

steps.assert: m.decided_by() == '' and not m.over and m.outcomes() == []
steps.msg: until tick 1800 team B could still clear in time: the race runs on

steps.assert: m.decided_by() == 'time' and m.outcomes() == [0, 1] and m.over and scene.decided_tick() == 1800
steps.msg: then team A has won on time
EV_RACE decided, with the outcomes and the rule
team B cleared 600 ticks later having lost nothing
the lower race time wins: team B
at tick 1200 a tie is still possible

steps.assert: m3.race_time(0) == 1200 and m3.race_time(1) == 1200 and m3.decided_by() == 'draw' and m3.outcomes() == [2, 2]
steps.msg: equal race times are a draw
